TreeRare incurs additional computa-
tional overhead due to its multi-stage decomposi-

loop_primitives.note: Bottom-up syntax-tree traversal: query generation, retrieval, subcomponent QA, then final answer.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote:
Given an input question Q, TreeRare converts it
into its corresponding syntax tree.
planning_granularity.note: The syntax tree acts as a structural decomposition of the question into sub-phrases. It is not an LLM plan and involves no delegation, so this is the closest-fit value.
